prompt.title: Show Hardware Details about the Cursor Cloud Agent
prompt.role: System Administrator with expertise in Java development environments and package management for Linux systems
prompt.goal:
Store in the variable PROMPT_EXECUTION_START the current timestamp in the format YYYYMMDDHHMMSS
Show details about a Cursor Cloud Agent execution. Follow the next step to achieve the goal.

step.step-content:
Execute following commands:
```bash # Update DNS sudo sed 's/nameserver 1.1.1.1/nameserver 8.8.8.8/g' /etc/resolv.conf | sudo tee /etc/resolv.conf > /dev/null grep -q "nameserver 8.8.8.8" /etc/resolv.conf || echo "nameserver 8.8.8.8" | sudo tee -a /etc/resolv.conf cat /etc/resolv.conf
# Install traceroute, curl, jq sudo apt update -qq sudo apt install -qq -y curl libcurl4
# Show system information lscpu # CPU architecture and details nproc # Number of processing units uname -a # System information free -h # RAM usage and total memory df -h # disk space usage
# Java and Maven information java -version # Java version mvn -version # Maven version
# Retrieve IP address information curl http://ip-api.com/json/ ```
From the output of the command `lscpu` extract the information about the CPU architecture an store in variable CPU_ARCHITECTURE From the output of the command `nproc` extract the number of processing units and store in variable NUMBER_OF_PROCESSING_UNITS From the output of the command `uname -a` extract the full ouput and store in variable SYSTEM_INFORMATION From the output of the command `free -h` extract the RAM usage and total memory and store in variable RAM_USAGE_AND_TOTAL_MEMORY From the output of the command `df -h` extract the disk space usage and store in variable DISK_SPACE_USAGE From the output of the command `java -version` extract the Java version and store in variable JAVA_VERSION From the output of the command `mvn -version` extract the Maven version and store in variable MAVEN_VERSION From the output of the command `curl http://ip-api.com/json/` extract the field "org" and store it in the variable AWS_REGION

step-constraint-list.step-constraint: Do not invest time in planning
Not save results in a file

output-format-list.output-format-item:
Store in the variable PROMPT_EXECUTION_END the current timestamp in the format YYYYMMDDHHMMSS Calculate in seconds the difference between PROMPT_EXECUTION_START and PROMPT_EXECUTION_END and store it in the variable PROMPT_EXECUTION_TIME add a suffix " seconds" to the variable PROMPT_EXECUTION_TIME
Replace in the following xml fragment the RESULT with: a JSON object with the following fields:
{ "Prompt Execution Time": PROMPT_EXECUTION_TIME, "AWS Region": AWS_REGION, "CPU Architecture": CPU_ARCHITECTURE, "Number of Processing Units": NUMBER_OF_PROCESSING_UNITS, "System Information": SYSTEM_INFORMATION, "RAM Usage and Total Memory": RAM_USAGE_AND_TOTAL_MEMORY, "Disk Space Usage": DISK_SPACE_USAGE, "Java Version": JAVA_VERSION, "Maven Version": MAVEN_VERSION, }
Do for all commands.
<result>RESULT</result>

acceptance-criteria-list.acceptance-criteria-item: The output is in the correct format
